figures.caption: Research framework of the proposed study, showing HVPD-DVCS auditing, matched model comparisons, fault-tolerant training, and test-set analysis.

Proposed SALF-DINO architecture showing the global DINOv3 pathway, fixed chart-border region attention, local depthwise-convolutional refinement, and gated residual fusion before binary classification.
Test macro-F1 (mean ± sample standard deviation across three independent seeds) for the five completed experimental configurations.
Mean number of srtAxY misclassifications per seed on the identical 872-chart test subset (lower is better).
Mean held-out macro-F1 under JPEG compression, Gaussian blur, and downsampling/upsampling, averaged over three seeds.

Genuine HVPD-DVCS training examples for the srtAxY category: (a) non-deceptive and (b) deceptive. Labels and file hashes were verified against the audited split; neither panel depicts a model prediction.

Two genuine held-out srtAxY chart images (seed 42): (a) a false positive and (b) a false negative of DINOv3 global pooling, both correctly classified by SALF-DINO. Panels were selected deterministically; see the source manifest for file hashes and probability scores.
